program.about: Competitive and a bit wicked, and it ends with you inside Mali. Every round of the partner circuit ends with a dare drawn by the timer, and whoever won the round decides who does it. The other day is all about winner's choice: win a round, pick the next position. The tease block is dares only. Level II adds reps, Level III holds everything longer.
